# Synthetic Dracula Pro fixture

The colours in `pro`, `blade` and `alucard` are invented. They are not the real Dracula Pro
themes, which are licensed and never committed to this repository.

The files exist so tests and builds can exercise the Dracula Pro derivation without a
licensed checkout: point `REX_DRACULA_PRO_DIR` at this directory. `pro` and `blade` are dark
and legible; `alucard` has a light background and so gets no chrome palette.
